narrative.en:
The deal was already in motion before the first card turned: Uniswap V4, twelve pools across eleven blocks, and nearly every one wearing a hook. That is not a night of idle hands; that is a volley. Two hook contracts sit at the center — 0x322dcec and 0x014257c — and they do not cross.

The first runs on zero fees; the second takes one percent. No zero-fee pool touches the second, no one-percent pool touches the first. A pattern, not a coincidence: two strategies dealt from separate shoes, each pulling liquidity through its own line. ETH/WETH shows up three times, with 0xc02aaa... paired against DOG, ELON, and another token — all on 0x322dcec at zero fees, the classic meme tray: low door, no rake, hooks doing the quiet work.

Then the odd chip: an AAVE pool with token 0xc98de..., also at one percent and the same hook. AAVE does not usually sit at a table like that. Either someone is testing a new borrowing mechanism through hooks, or it is a warm-up before a larger hand. And two native ETH pools — 0x000... against different tokens — split their loyalties: one with hook 0xb8d94, the other with 0x014257c, different fees, different hooks, same base. Someone is trying configurations on one foundation.

Twelve pools in eleven blocks. That is not drift; that is a batch of strategies set down at once, like cards fanned across the felt. Now the house waits to see which suit draws blood.
narrative.zh:
昨夜江湖不静。Uniswap V4 的门前，十一息之间挤出十二座新池，几乎座座都挂了钩子。不是零散脚步，是有人一口气布阵，先落子，再看风向。

阵眼在两枚钩子合约：0x322dcec 与 0x014257c。前者走零费，后者抽一分；两条线互不交叉——零费之池不碰后者，一分之池不沾前者。这是两套心法，各引各的内力。ETH/WETH 三度现身，0xc02aaa... 分别与 DOG、ELON 及另一枚代币结伴，皆挂在 0x322dcec 的零费门下；低门槛，无抽水，钩子暗管调度，是典型的迷因江湖局。

却有一手耐人寻味：AAVE 与 0xc98de... 同池，也是一分费、同一钩子。AAVE 这等老门派，向来少与激进招式同席。若非有人借钩子试新的借贷法门，便只是大阵前的一次试手。另有二池以原生 ETH 为底——0x000... 与不同代币相配，一挂 0xb8d94，一挂 0x014257c；费不同，钩不同，根却同。有人在同一块地基上试诸般构造。

十二池，十一息。这不是偶遇，是齐射。像侠客把一整套招式同时摊在桌上，等哪一式先见血。

take.en: The signal is not the tokens on the table but the two non-intersecting hook contracts: two strategies, two fee regimes, deployed in a single volley, and the market will soon show which one the house respects.
take.zh: 今日看点不在代币名头，而在两枚互不相交的钩子：两套心法、两种抽成，同一夜齐出；江湖很快会告诉我们，哪一路内力更得人心。

narrative.en:
Sixteen fresh pools hit the felt on the last day of September, and nearly every one of them is dealt from the same deck — a single hook, 0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0, stamped across the spread like a dealer's thumbprint on the whole hand. That is not a coincidence and it is not enthusiasm. That is one man who bought the table a round and intends to keep dealing until the chairs empty.

The tell is fe99b2fe66c7725ce30730010a864740e7c39b26 — one token turning up in six separate pools, each one paired against a different counterparty from a whole fan of addresses: fef2e0e0e25ecf263e790ad860e646373c273efb, ff3c1679633dcf01d91d2977f651d6628871af98, ff972b1ab6f11509aeb71a3157a67a4ac1d22de5, and the rest. Same 10000 commission on all of them, same hook over the top. One sleeve, shuffled six ways. But the sharper hand is the one charging nothing at all — three pools with zero commission under hook 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc, each sitting against the null address and each paired with a different token: 0x6860692a743f61e02b90372c7fda25e119d1c825, 0xc87dd48f5fae85355d629fbd0438ee02c4d0830d, 0xa77f0481a8754bdf3ad0353e60a1002c136302bf. Zero commission is never an accident. It is a position.

Two more zero-commission pools ride under hook 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc — one WETH against cfd59f7f768b03b542a9c09643dbf4c13888f220, the other a pair of exotics, 032dec3372f25c41ea8054b4987a7c4832cdb338 against e0910a2f0a3754a2e5e256e2b70af19178b46413. Different suits, same dealer. And one last pool under hook 0x11e7a9d7c0dbe78fca899708276791f70dad20cc, null address against 664e9d73db2a3514f6b437137de4779977a06e81, again with nothing taken off the top. The whole stretch of blocks labeled 26087, from 26086706 through 26087139, is somebody's shift work. Nobody deals like that by hand. The cards are already face up on the table — the only thing still hidden is who is sitting behind them, and what game they think they're playing.
narrative.zh:
九月三十，江湖上忽然多出十六口新池子。抬眼一看，十几口都挂着同一个钩子——0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0。像是同一门派的暗记，齐齐刻在井沿上。这不是巧合，是有人包下了整座酒楼，酒还没上，椅子先摆好了。

最惹眼的是 fe99b2fe66c7725ce30730010a864740e7c39b26。这一味东西，一口气出现在六口池子里，每一口都配着不同的对手：fef2e0e0e25ecf263e790ad860e646373c273efb、ff3c1679633dcf01d91d2977f651d6628871af98、ff972b1ab6f11509aeb71a3157a67a4ac1d22de5，还有别的。抽头一律 10000，钩子一模一样。一个人，六条线。可真正见功力的，是那些一分不取的——三口零抽成的池子，同挂在钩子 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 下，对面都是空地址，各配一味不同的东西：0x6860692a743f61e02b90372c7fda25e119d1c825、0xc87dd48f5fae85355d629fbd0438ee02c4d0830d、0xa77f0481a8754bdf3ad0353e60a1002c136302bf。不收内力，从来不是随性，是有所图。

另有两口零抽成的池子，走在钩子 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 之下：一口是 WETH 对着 cfd59f7f768b03b542a9c09643dbf4c13888f220，另一口是两味偏门东西对坐——032dec3372f25c41ea8054b4987a7c4832cdb338 对 e0910a2f0a3754a2e5e256e2b70af19178b46413。路子不同，出手的是同一个人。最后还有一口，钩子 0x11e7a9d7c0dbe78fca899708276791f70dad20cc，空地址对着 664e9d73db2a3514f6b437137de4779977a06e81，同样分文不取。从 26086706 到 26087139，整整一片，是有人在按班次干活。手打不出这样的速度。牌已摊在桌上，只差看清执牌的是谁。

take.en: This is not a trader working a pool, it is a machine feeding a table — and the house never runs a conveyor this steady unless it already knows how the hand ends.
take.zh: 这不是谁在池边讨生活，是有人在往桌上一口一口地灌内力——能这么匀、这么稳的，多半早已想好了这局要怎么收。

narrative.en:
The scanner blinked and the felt was already crowded — fifteen fresh pools on Uniswap V4 between midnight and morning, and that is only what the scan caught. One hook address keeps turning up in every second deal: 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc. Same hand, laid over and over with surgical calm. The spacing is uniform at 200, the house takes nothing on the swap. That is a tell, not a mystery: pools built this way are not for trading across the spread, they are built for a script — staking, an order hook, a fee that moves with the weather.

Two of them sit against ETH. WETH against 0xa4717b31144d2cd0b5cdfa4ad8d650c2c7229294, and another against 0x34d50e4f5ff26f28a9bd8b61c327d9cd9dc85e70. Fresh addresses, no history worth reading. Either a new face at the table, or an old one in a new coat.

The interesting three are the ones paired with nothing at all — native ETH, the zero address. One charges 8388608 on the encoded scale, the smallest sliver of a percent, with a spacing of ten; a fine mesh, built for things that barely move. The other two charge nothing and carry different hooks: 0x834deb... and 0xcba491... Different hooks, different rules. One might simply watch the clock and average it; the other might hold orders until somebody wants them.

And on GitHub, no fanfare: merge request #202 into uniswap-hooks, the static analyser's findings found and closed, and the author walked on without a word. The picture of the night is assembly. Someone is stacking a deck, and not on their knee. Every pool a card, every hook a suit. The only question left is who is dealing, and which trump is still in hand.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，Uniswap V4 上多出十五个新池，这还只是扫描器扫到的数目。同一个钩子地址反复浮现——0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc，隔一个池便见一次。落子极稳，间距一律二百，抽成取零。江湖里这样做局的人，不为赚一买一卖的差价，而是另有章程：或为质押，或为挂单，或让抽成随行情自行起落。

其中两个池以 ETH 相对：WETH 对 0xa4717b31144d2cd0b5cdfa4ad8d650c2c7229294，另一个对 0x34d50e4f5ff26f28a9bd8b61c327d9cd9dc85e70。地址新鲜，来历空白，或是新门派立山门，或是旧门派换了行头。

真正耐看的是那三个与零地址相对的池，即以原生 ETH 为对。一个抽成记作 8388608，细到不足一分，间距只有十，网格极密，是为那些几乎不动的资产所设。另两个分文不取，却挂了不同的钩子：0x834deb... 与 0xcba491...。钩子不同，规矩便不同。一个或许专记时辰、取其均值；一个或许替人守住价位，等号令再动。

GitHub 那边无声无息：uniswap-hooks 仓库的 #202 合并请求过了，静态分析查出的破绽已经补好，提剑的人收势便走，不留名号。今夜的图景是布阵。有人在码牌，码得齐整。每个池是一张牌，每个钩子是一门花色。剩下的问题只有：发牌的是谁，手里还捏着哪张王牌。

take.en: Fifteen pools and one hook address repeated like a signature — this is scaffolding being raised, not a trade being placed. The noise is the framework; the signal is the hand that keeps signing it.
take.zh: 十五个池，一个钩子地址如印记般反复加盖——这是有人在内力筑基，不是在赌桌上押注。噪声是脚手架，信号是那支始终在签名的笔。

narrative.en:
The deck was deep into the evening and the hand stayed steady. 0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0—that hook provider's contract cuts through every second block like a house dealer's thumbprint. Seven pools in twenty-four hours, four of them wearing its mark. Tokens from 0x000...000 to WBTC, USDC, WETH. Fees pinned at 10000—one percent—across the felt. Don't ask why anyone nails that grid over stables; the house doesn't explain its tells.

Then an odd run: two zero-fee hands in a row, 0xcba49142a75da64a679f32a159f4316f11a7e0cc. Three pools inside fifteen minutes. One on USDC, one on an ETH/USDT-like pair, one on some 0x4a220e... that smells like an internal service token. A zero-fee pool with spacing 200 is either a test or an arbitrage hub for a pair whose spread is already dead. Two more follow with the same hook contract but stamped 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc—also zero fee. Two competing hook providers on one chain have started a round.

The most interesting hand sat on block 26072583: ETH against 0xfd62d038... with 3000 and spacing 60. A classic mid-frequency pair, moderate fee. But the hook—0x579461052bbe2d8b6dcb0c97dfdc63da718280cc—I'd never seen before. Either a new project or someone testing a dynamic fee mechanism.

By night's end the deck was incomplete. Pool 0xecabdcad8f40745fa7addbc1b09dc3e857bd25482043f1bd7693c49088d76cfc—ETH on 0x76bf1591... with zero fee and spacing 60. Nonsense: with that narrow a step, zero fee hands perfect arbitrage to the bots. Either a trap or someone forgot to change the parameters. Exactly fifteen pools in twenty-four hours. Not one dynamic fee. All—zero, 3000, or 10000. Three different hook contracts, but 0x0142... dominates. The deck shuffles, but the suit is one: V4.
narrative.zh:
夜色深沉，江湖上又起了几阵风。 合约 0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0 如一枚旧令牌，在每个区块间闪烁。 二十四时内七池，四池有它。 代币从 0x000...000 到 WBTC、USDC、WETH。 手续费皆钉在 10000，即一分。 稳定币上布此阵，未免古怪；门派不说，旁人也不必问。

另有一串零费之局：0xcba49142a75da64a679f32a159f4316f11a7e0cc，十五分钟内三池。 一池 USDC，一池似 ETH/USDT 之配，一池 0x4a220e... 像是内门信物。 零费而间距 200，非试炼，即套利死局。 随后两池同钩，却换作 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc，亦零费。 两派钩师，同链竞逐，一局已开。

最奇者，块 26072583：ETH 对 0xfd62d038...，费 3000，间距 60。 中频之局，费率中庸。 然钩为 0x579461052bbe2d8b6dcb0c97dfdc63da718280cc，前所未见。 或新门派初立，或有人试动态费之机。

夜尽，牌局未全。 池 0xecabdcad8f40745fa7addbc1b09dc3e857bd25482043f1bd7693c49088d76cfc：ETH 对 0x76bf1591...，零费，间距 60。 窄步零费，直为械斗之利。 若非陷阱，便是忘改参数。 二十四时内，恰十五池。 无一动态费。 费率非 0，即 3000，或 10000。 钩有三约，0x0142... 独大。 牌洗未停，花色唯 V4。

take.en: Fifteen pools in a day, fees clustered at zero, 3000, or 10000, and three hooks fighting for the same felt—V4 is not diversifying; it's consolidating its costume.
take.zh: 一日十五池，费率只三档，钩者三家，而 0x0142... 独揽大势。 江湖看似多门，其实衣钵仍归 V4。

narrative.en:
Seven tables opened since midnight, and the felt is still warm. One contract — 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0 — keeps showing up at the deal. The same address in the last three seatings, pairing its tokens off one after another, every one of them cut from the same cloth: the same cut of the house's rake, the same spacing on the grid. That is not a player. That is a dealer shuffling one deck and laying down different hands.

Earlier, a different hand. Two tokens with nothing taken off the top — zero rake — and a fresh contract behind them, 0x322dcec4, not of the first one's bloodline. When a maker takes nothing at the door, he is not there to trade. He is there for a mechanic: something that moves the price, something that whispers to an oracle, something meant to be fed by other people's arbitrage. Then a table with real ether on it — the coin with the all-zero address — against 0xd3dfd3a7, again with no rake, behind hooks at 0xb8d9477e. Ether sits down rarely at this kind of table, and only when the purpose is specific: shielding a fill, or holding a lot for a set hour and no longer.

And the latest, before all that — a plain-looking pair, the stable against 0xdae0fafd, with an ordinary rake of 3000 and a grid at 65, but a hook at 0xb9993c10 sitting behind it. Standard odds, unstandard hands. Somebody wants to steer the liquidity or sift the swaps as they pass through.

Seven in a handful of hours is not impulse. Somebody is building furniture, not playing. The question was never what the chips are; it is who owns the chair. A hook is not decoration — it is a hand on the valve. And when one address keeps stacking tables, it is not gambling, it is preparation. I watch the deck assemble. I do not yet know who will move first.
narrative.zh:
自子夜起，江湖上已摆开七张桌子。同一个门派的手笔——合约 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0，在最近三次开坛中接连现身，所配之对虽各不相同，抽成与格距却如出一辙：同一种内力，同一种刻度。这不是散修的偶遇，是有人在同一副牌里，换着发不同的一手。

更早之前，另一路人马。两枚代币，分文不取——抽成为零，背后的合约 0x322dcec4 尚且新嫩，与前者并非同门。开门不取分毫的人，从来不是来做买卖的。他要的是一门机关：或是随势而变的抽成，或是探听消息的耳目，或是专为承接他人套利而设的阵眼。而后又有一桌，摆的是真金——那枚全零地址的以太——对上 0xd3dfd3a7，同样不取分毫，钩子在 0xb8d9477e。以太在这类局上极少落座，一旦落座，必有专图：或为护住一笔成交，或为限定时辰的存押。

最新的一桌，倒像是寻常生意：稳定币对 0xdae0fafd，抽成三千，格距六十五，规矩分明，钩子 0xb9993c10 却伏在暗处。寻常的赔率，不寻常的手法——有人要把流动性握在手里，或要在每一笔过路的水流上设一道筛。

数个时辰之内摆出七桌，这不是随性，是有人在打地基。要紧的从来不是筹码是什么，而是谁坐在庄位上。钩子不是摆设，是按住水闸的那只手。同一个地址接连开坛，便不是赌，是备。我看着这副牌一张张铺开，还看不出是谁先出手。

take.en: This is not a hot streak at the tables — it is one hand quietly building the room, and rooms get built for someone else to walk into.
take.zh: 这不是赌桌上的一阵手气，而是有人在替别人把屋子盖好——屋子盖起来，总归是等着有人入席。

narrative.en:
Fourteen new pools on the V4 felt in a handful of hours, every one of them dealt with a hook attached. The deals came fast — the ledger barely breathes between them — and the same signature keeps surfacing: one hook address, 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0, four times, always with the same fee constant and the same wide spacing between its price rungs. Whoever is behind that one is not fishing for pennies. They are building for violent pairs that need room to thrash.

The other tell is quieter and stranger. Hook 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc showed up twice carrying a fee of nothing at all, ETH on one side against tokens nobody has named. A house that takes no rake is not a generous house — it is a house that has found another door to the money, and no one has shown us which door. Meanwhile the null address, plain ETH, walked into five separate pools; five new roads out of the same square.

One of them sits at a single point in the ledger — ETH against 0x2710cc54f272bf543cb45c2a8841e7cce8f8f1d4, fee of nothing, hook 0xcba49142a75da64a679f32a159f4316f11a7e0cc. The counterparty token is unreadable from here. But the pattern is legible enough: if someone will supply liquidity for free, the payment is arriving from somewhere off the table.

And in the git, gonzaotc is closing gaps four at a time — overrides that do not forward, a fee that is only reported and never collected, tests for removals, the zero-native refund. That is not maintenance. That is a man nailing the floorboards down before the room fills. Documentation is what you write when you want strangers to copy your hooks and build on them. V4 is turning from a protocol into a platform. The deck is being assembled in plain sight. All that remains is to see who throws first.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，Uniswap V4 的江湖上又多了十四个新池，个个都带着暗器般的挂钩。区块一个挨一个，几乎不留喘息，像同一双手在连发。有一枚挂钩地址 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0 现身四次，每一次都是同样的抽成、同样宽阔的桩距——这不是撒网捞小钱的路数，是给剧烈震荡的对手留出招架的空间。

另一枚则静得出奇。挂钩 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 两次现身，抽成为零，一边是 ETH，另一边是不曾报名的代币。开门不收香火钱的堂口，未必是善堂，多半是另有一条进项的路子，只是那条路还没人指给我们看。而空地址，也就是 ETH 本尊，走进了五个不同的池子——同一个山门，五条新路。

其中一条落在账本上的某一点：ETH 对 0x2710cc54f272bf543cb45c2a8841e7cce8f8f1d4，抽成为零，挂钩 0xcba49142a75da64a679f32a159f4316f11a7e0cc。对手方是谁，从这里看不真切。但若有人肯白送内力，报酬必是从别处来。

与此同时，侠客 gonzaotc 在代码仓里一夜连递四份文书——不转发的覆写、只作申报而不收取的抽成、移除路径的试探、以及归还本币为零的那一处。这不是修修补补，这是赶在宾客入席之前把地板钉牢。肯写文档的人，是想让陌生的后来者照着自己的式子练功。V4 正在从一个门派，长成一座可以开门收徒的武林。牌已经摊在桌面上，只看谁先出手。

take.en: Fourteen hooked pools and one developer closing four documentation gaps in a night is not noise on the felt — it is a platform being furnished for guests who have not arrived yet; the zero-fee hooks are the only card face-down, and whoever profits without a rake is the one worth watching.
take.zh: 十四个带挂钩的池子，加上一位侠客一夜补齐四处文档缺口——这不是江湖上的杂音，而是有人正在为尚未登门的宾客布置厅堂；零抽成的那两枚挂钩是唯一扣着的牌，不收香火钱却仍有进项的人，才值得盯住。

narrative.en:
Sixteen pools, thirty blocks, one hand dealing. The contract at 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0 does not hesitate — identical parameters every time, same commission, same spread, no pause between deals. That is not a gambler at the table. That is a croupier who has already counted the deck.

Look at the pairs. Four of them open against the zero address — that is wrapped ether, the anchor, the base of the felt. The rest are tokens with short pedigrees, some with no liquidity behind them at all. PEPE surfaces twice, once against an unknown counterparty, once against 0x94eaa7251889269765eab45279741a3031840089. And 0x47accd13264d8f954105256faac8376ce6a55999 shows up three times, each time with a different quote on the other side. One base, three partners. Somebody is drawing a grid.

0xc9eef266834730340a55b6cc24621b31baf55581 repeats too — two pools, different pairs, one block between them. And one hook binds them all. A hook like that is not a casual deployment; it is custom machinery, the kind that reaches into a swap before and after it lands, watching, adjusting. Someone is either running an experiment or laying pipe for something larger.

Every pool is initialized. That does not mean a single coin sits in any of them. If this is only the marking of the field, we hear nothing more. If deposits follow, the shuffle was real. For now: preparation. Clean, fast, no wasted motion. Not one duplicate, not one failure. Whoever this is, they know exactly what they are doing.
narrative.zh:
三十个区块，十六个池子，一条钩子合约一手落子。0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0，招招同式，费率如一，间距如一，中间不留喘息。这不是江湖人随手试剑，这是有人在自家山门前，一寸一寸地量地。

看配对。四池以零地址为基，那是 wrapped ether，是内力最厚的地基。余下的多是新面孔，有些连起手的流动性都还没有。PEPE 现身两次，一次对着无名之辈，一次对着 0x94eaa7251889269765eab45279741a3031840089。而 0x47accd13264d8f954105256faac8376ce6a55999 三度登场，每次对家不同——一个底座，三种手法，这是在布阵，不是在下注。

0xc9eef266834730340a55b6cc24621b31baf55581 也复现了，两池两对，相隔一个区块。十六池同归一钩。钩者，能在换手前后伸手，看得见、也改得动——这不是寻常的合约，这是某个门派的独门心法。有人在试招，也有人在为一场更大的开山做准备。

池子都立起来了，但不等于里面有钱。若只是画地为界，此后当是一片沉寂；若真有人随后注入内力，那便是牌已洗过，局要开了。眼下的动作干净、快、不拖泥带水，无一招重复，无一招落空。此人心里有谱。

take.en: Sixteen pools in thirty blocks from a single hook is not noise and it is not a trade — it is infrastructure being laid, and the only question worth asking is whether liquidity follows the scaffolding or the field stays empty.
take.zh: 三十个区块十六池，同出一钩，这不是噪声也不是买卖，而是有人在山门前丈量地基——接下来要看的是内力会不会跟着涌进来，还是这片地就此空置。

narrative.en:
Last night the deck dealt two cards in a row, same pattern showing. Two V4 pools with hooks, initialized 260 blocks apart — first at 26043662, second at 26043922 — both pairing native ETH with tokens walking in from the same back room. The addresses are 0xbc3a8ab9a5617d3f7a58df1b5a851c0254e970f7 and 0xf8bd4871a19acf8d1ffefbb6535d80677af0c740: not scrap, not test dummies, live contracts with history. The only tell between them is the spacing: one set at 200, the other at 60 — different depth, different crowd. 200 is for wide swings; 60 is for aggressive play inside a narrow range.

Both pools run zero fees. In V4 that means the rake doesn't move through the standard mechanism; it moves through hooks. 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc and 0xe6a1b2c9ab579721cc82888ca7d1b07d7fe54500 aren't just contracts; they're the logic deciding who gets paid and how much. Somebody is clearly preparing mechanics where the cut isn't distributed by the old book.

The real tell is the window. Two pools, two hooks, two different parameter sets — all inside one narrow stretch. That isn't chance. Somebody is dealing a grid, testing a strategy, or laying groundwork for a more complex construction. Maybe one hook steers the other, or they're tied through a shared oracle. Pool IDs: 0x3796c7b34e56269629b6ffae92c2a6614f5eb1a9a3c705db4a4fe4bab9d579d3 and 0xc37eaf5b93ceaab0fa1aff3a1eb93e6701747e0e9aa0e5be089e916fae4ab82f. Different hands, same shuffling algorithm. All that's left is to wait for the next cards.
narrative.zh:
昨夜江湖并排亮起两盏灯：两座 V4 池，带钩，前后只差二百六十个区块落子——先者 26043662，后者 26043922。二者都以原生 ETH 配对外来代币，而那些代币同出一门。地址是 0xbc3a8ab9a5617d3f7a58df1b5a851c0254e970f7 与 0xf8bd4871a19acf8d1ffefbb6535d80677af0c740，不是废纸，也不是试剑石，是有过往的活契约。二者只差一线：刻度一宽二百，一窄六十。宽者容大开大合，窄者供人在狭处快进快出。内力深浅不同，来路自然不同。

两池皆零费。V4 之中，这意味着收益不走旧路，而由钩来分。0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 与 0xe6a1b2c9ab579721cc82888ca7d1b07d7fe54500 不只是合约，是决定谁得多少的规矩。有人显然在布一套新算盘：抽成不再按老谱来分。

最要紧的是时辰。两池、两钩、两套参数，却落在同一扇窗里。这不是偶然。有人在下网，或试阵，或在为更复杂的楼阁打地基。也许一钩驭另一钩，也许二者共用一座神谕。池引：0x3796c7b34e56269629b6ffae92c2a6614f5eb1a9a3c705db4a4fe4bab9d579d3 与 0xc37eaf5b93ceaab0fa1aff3a1eb93e6701747e0e9aa0e5be089e916fae4ab82f。看似不同，细看却像同一只手在洗牌，只是算法代了手。接下来翻什么牌，只能等。

take.en: Two pools, two hooks, one window — the house isn't decorating the felt, it's rewriting how the rake moves.
take.zh: 两池两钩同落一窗，说明有人不在装饰门面，而在改抽成的规矩。牌未翻尽，先看洗牌的手。

narrative.en:
Block 26037053, and the felt has a new V4 pool on Uniswap: 0xd31a59c85ae9d8edefec411d448f90841571b89c against 0xf542782ca8082c4d5bcdd1ffb3c006be54170bd5, stake 10000, spacing 200, hook at 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0. This is not a random pair — one of the tokens I have already seen in the previous deal. Someone is collecting the deck.

Three blocks back, 26036523: 0xc84782858b7bef5d25182dbac956a6aa463aefe5 against USDT, 3000 basis points, spacing 61, hook at 0x8409dd13074e8018c3999d8405a6d328f19d2a80. USDT on V4 is a rarity. Stablecoins usually stay on the old suits. Here, someone chose to play a new hand.

Fourteen blocks before that, 26036539: ETH against 0xc8987e2a5c68a881d7f4c0bc6130697ae891f91e, zero fee, spacing 200, hook at 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc. Free entry always has a smell — liquidity for a specific scenario, or a live bait for the arbitrageur.

And 26036885: ETH against 0x285f8dcc3094f86ec20adfe3c150611993c1ffff, fee 8388608 — the maximum, almost blocking. Spacing 10, a narrow corridor. Hook at 0xf067c780c18e230958fb35c2455cee381864e0c0. Someone is putting up a wall. Four pools in one session. Different pairs, different strategies. One deals fast without looking; another shuffles for the long game. I just watch the cards fall.
narrative.zh:
区块 26037053，江湖的桌面上又多了一个 Uniswap V4 新池：0xd31a59c85ae9d8edefec411d448f90841571b89c 对 0xf542782ca8082c4d5bcdd1ffb3c006be54170bd5，费率 10000，步距 200，钩子在 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0。这不是随手一局——其中一个代币，我在上一场里见过。有人正在收牌。

再往前三个区块，26036523：0xc84782858b7bef5d25182dbac956a6aa463aefe5 对 USDT，三千基点，步距 61，钩子在 0x8409dd13074e8018c3999d8405a6d328f19d2a80。USDT 落于 V4，是少见的事。稳定币素来守旧，多留在旧门派的牌桌上。此处却有人偏要换一种打法。

再往前十四个区块，26036539：ETH 对 0xc8987e2a5c68a881d7f4c0bc6130697ae891f91e，零费，步距 200，钩子在 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc。免费的入口，总带着气味。要么是为某种特定局面备下的内力，要么是给套利客下的活饵。

还有 26036885：ETH 对 0x285f8dcc3094f86ec20adfe3c150611993c1ffff，费 8388608——极高，几乎封路。步距 10，窄巷一条。钩子在 0xf067c780c18e230958fb35c2455cee381864e0c0。有人在这里筑墙。一局四池，牌面各异，心法各异。有人发牌快而不看，有人洗牌图的是长局。我只在旁看牌落。

take.en: Four pools in one session, each with its own hook and appetite: someone is not playing a hand, they are building a deck. The pattern is the tell, not any single card.
take.zh: 一局四池，四枚钩子，四般心法：这不是随手押注，是有人在攒一副牌。信号在牌路，不在单张牌面。

narrative.en:
The night's mempool dealt a hand that doesn't smell like chance. Ten pools, zero fee, all from the same hook contract — 0xb741a710 — firing inside fourteen blocks, ETH paired against ten different tokens, spacing set at 60. Nobody deals ten identical structures by accident. Either a simulation swarm for hook mechanics, or a basket staged for a gas-priority arb bot. Too synchronized to be a stray shuffle.

Earlier, block 26029489 laid down two more from 0xefe3aa7df: PYTH/USDC with one basis point and spacing 10, and a second pool, 0x22ae3d9a against 0x6c3ea903, zero fee, same spacing. Both in one block. Dense grid, high-volatility hunting — someone knows the felt and where to place the chips.

The pearl: block 26029503, USDT against 0xdae0fafd65385e7775cf75b1398735155ef6acd2, fee 8388608. That's the ceiling — one hundred percent. Not a trading pool. A hook intermediary taking the whole cut, or a way to pin flow direction without fear of withdrawal. The kind of move made when you want execution outside the standard route.

The deck is being seeded with every strategy from high-frequency grid to fee-locked exotics. The house doesn't shuffle this deliberately without a reason.
narrative.zh:
今夜 mempool 里递出的这一手，不像偶然。同一个 hook 合约 0xb741a710，在十四个区块内连续开出十个零费率池，以太坊对十个不同代币，间距 60。这不像随手落子，倒像有人在试招，或是在为某路抢跑机器人摆好棋阵。太整齐，整齐得不似江湖偶遇。

更早，区块 26029489，0xefe3aa7df 出手两次：一对 PYTH/USDC，一点基点的费率，间距 10；另一对 0x22ae3d9a 与 0x6c3ea903，零费率，同一间距。同一区块，两处落子。间距密，网格细，是给波动大的对手留的陷阱，每一步都要算到毫厘。

最后是那枚暗器。区块 26029503，USDT 对 0xdae0fafd65385e7775cf75b1398735155ef6acd2，费率 8388608。不是笔误。那是 V4 的极值——百分之百。此池不为交易，倒像是 hook 坐庄全取，或是锁住流向、不留撤池余地。行此手者，多半是想绕过寻常路径，确保一击必中。

江湖一夜间，有人在高频网格与锁费异术之间逐一试剑。内力流向不是无故翻涌，牌已重新洗过。

take.en: Ten zero-fee pools in fourteen blocks from one hook contract is a stress test, not a trade; the signal is in the synchronization, not the liquidity.
take.zh: 同一个 hook 合约十四个区块内连开十池，这已是阵势，不是散户随手；真正值得看的，是这股同步的节奏，而非池中那点浅水。

narrative.en:
The night dealt from two different decks and pretended it was one hand. Two pools came up with zero fee, both holding ETH on one end — the first opened at block 26022498, hook 0xadb9..., spread at sixty ticks; the second at block 26022216, a different hook at 0xe9d9..., same mechanic, ETH against 0x2a64.... Nobody sets the house's cut to nothing because he expects to eat from the rake. Zero commission inside a V4 hook pool is either a rehearsal or a wager that the money arrives through the hook itself — order flow, sequencing, the quiet rearrangement of transactions before the felt ever sees them.

Three more tables took the ordinary cut: fee 8388608, which lands somewhere near 0.01% once V4 scaling has its say. The eldest opened at block 26022191, ETH against 0xd979c..., hook 0x05c9..., sixty ticks. Then 26022284 pairing 0x3074... with 0x8de3..., tickSpacing 200 — wider teeth, a pair that expects to move, or a hook that manages its ranges with a heavier hand. The freshest came at 26022621: 0xc847... against USDT (0xdac1...), hook 0xb0bb..., sixty ticks again.

Every one of these hooks is a stranger. Not a single one wears an address from a deployment I know. Four new contracts, unverified, dealing into a room that has not been told the rules. The USDT table is the one worth the candle — if someone is routing stablecoin liquidity through a custom hook, that is either a protocol-specific optimization or a mechanism with a second purpose nobody has printed on the card.

Eleven new deals were laid out overnight. The question was never which of them wins. The question is which ones are still on the felt when the morning crowd walks in.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，江湖上多出十一处新开的场子。其中两处的规矩最是古怪：抽成归零，内力却押在ETH一边。头一处开在26022498区块，hook是0xadb9...，寻常价差六十个tick；第二处在26022216，hook换了0xe9d9...，手法如出一辙——零费，ETH与0x2a64...相对。开门不收过路钱的人，若不是在试招，便是另有所图：费用不在场内取，而在hook之中取。

另外三处仍按老规矩抽成，fee 8388608，折算下来约莫万分之一。最年长的一处开在26022191，ETH对0xd979c...，hook 0x05c9...，六十个tick。其后是26022284，0x3074...与0x8de3...相对，tickSpacing 200——价差拉得宽，说明这对内力浮躁，或是背后有个出手凶悍的hook在圈定范围。最新的一处落在26022621：0xc847...对USDT（0xdac1...），hook 0xb0bb...，仍旧是六十个tick。

这几处的hook，没有一个是我认得的老面孔。四个新合约，未曾验明正身，就这么摆上了台面。尤其那处与USDT相对的——若真有人要把稳定币的内力经由自定义hook引进来，那是专为某一门派量身定制，还是暗藏机关，此刻还看不透。

场子多，不等于热闹。零费的ETH盘子已经把话说得很明白：有人不在乎流动性提供者的进项，只在乎地基搭不搭得起来。这十一处新局，哪一处能撑到天明，天亮之前，谁也说不准。

take.en: Zero-fee ETH pools and four unverified hooks in a single night is not income being built — it is infrastructure being built, and infrastructure is always a stake placed before the odds are posted.
take.zh: 零费的ETH场子配上四个来路不明的hook——这不是冲着利钱去的，是在铺路。铺路的人，从不问今夜的输赢。

narrative.en:
Two pools on Unichain, and the felt barely quivered — a thin table, the kind you walk past without slowing. The first arrived at block 59118648: the zero address paired against token 0x19ae, fee 0, tickSpacing 200, hook 0x9463. Zero fee on a V4 with a hook is rarely charity — it usually means the hook itself is collecting through dynamic mechanisms. The second, block 59115468, was more conventional: WETH against 0x5388, fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, hook 0x6277. Two hands is not a table.

Ethereum was another room entirely. At block 26015141 the same hook contract, 0xb741, began opening pools against the zero address with different tokens — fee 0, tickSpacing 60, eight pools in a row, down through 26015120. That is not a gambler's improvisation. That is a dealer working from a script, laying a grid of liquidity around a single hook. Serial deployment, automated, either a test distribution or a strategy where the hook owns the whole logic.

Then, at 26015133, a different hook — 0x5dab — with 0x823f against WETH, fee 3000. Single. Off-series. And notice what repeats: on Ethereum nearly every new pool holds the zero address on one side, which means the other side is an ERC-20 and the pool is built to trade against the native currency through a wrapper. Fee of zero on such pairs is rare — arbitrage, or fees collected externally by the hook.

For the record, the day's highlight facts: 19930, 19931, 19932, 19933, 19934. And the thing worth saying plainly — V4 with hooks is no longer liquidity. It is programmable liquidity. Someone is building something larger than a pool. The only open question is what.
narrative.zh:
江湖一夜，Unichain 只摆开两处新池，内力稀薄，不成气候。第一处在 59118648 区块：零地址对 0x19ae，fee 为 0，tickSpacing 200，钩子 0x9463——过路钱分文不取，多半是钩子自己另设抽成之法。第二处在 59115468：WETH 对 0x5388，fee 3000，tickSpacing 60，另一枚钩子 0x6277。两池而已，不足挂齿。

真正的动静在以太坊。自 26015141 区块起，同一枚钩子 0xb741 接连开池，皆以零地址配不同代币，fee 皆 0，tickSpacing 皆 60，一口气排到 26015120，八池成列。这不是随手落子，是有人按阵图布阵，多半是自动化的手笔——或为试演分派，或为一门由钩子独掌全局的功法。

26015133，另有一枚钩子 0x5dab，0x823f 对 WETH，fee 3000，孤零零一池，不入阵。可留意者：以太坊新池几乎都以零地址为一方，另一方必是 ERC-20，此池多半是为借包装之币与原生之币相搏而设。此类对上 fee 为 0，实属罕见——或行走套利之途，或由钩子在池外收租。

今日留档五个数字：19930、19931、19932、19933、19934。带钩的 V4，已不是死水般的内力，而是可编程的内力。有人所建，不止于池。至于建的是什么，江湖尚未见分晓。

take.en: Eight pools from one hook contract in a single run is not trading, it is construction — and V4 hooks have turned liquidity itself into code that can be written to order.
take.zh: 一枚钩子连开八池，是布阵，不是试手。V4 的流动性已被写成可编程的内力，规矩正在换。

narrative.en:
Three deals off the same shoe, and the house isn't taking a cut. Blocks 26007858, 26007954, 26008098 — three Uniswap V4 initializations in a row, every one carrying a hook, every one posted at zero fee with a tick spacing of 200. ETH against 0xbd965230588eaa536de6aa45e8ebbc01638535e0 first, then 0x6987ffcfa6167afb69b19e23bf1de602b628c7ea, then 0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be. No rake on the felt. That is not an oversight; that is a claim staked in public.

Zero fee on V4 means the house collects elsewhere, or intends to. A hook may levy its own dynamic fee, or waive fees entirely and live off other currents — dynamic swaps, limit orders, liquidity maneuvers. Tick spacing 200 sets wider rungs on the ladder, the kind you use for volatile or niche pairs where nobody is asking for a jeweler's precision. And the pattern of the hooks is where the tell sits: three token addresses, two hook contracts, one of them — 0x71f0feb4213c19aa2c0763e3594788e12a7641cd — called twice, on the first pool and the third. That reads as a multi-pool hook running several pairs through a single logic. The other, 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc, appears once: bespoke, experimental, cut for one token's particular mechanism.

ETH paired against zero-fee satellites usually signals a bootstrap — seed liquidity, or trade whose revenue arrives from somewhere other than the fee: arbitrage, flash swaps, rewards for managing positions. Pools like these sit in the dark until someone starts leaning on them. I'm watching the contracts. A first swap or a first liquidity add inside a few hours will say plainly who laid these cards and what they're playing for. Until then they are three faces down on the felt, and the deck is still being shuffled.
narrative.zh:
又是三处新立的山门，皆挂零费之旗。区块 26007858、26007954、26008098，接连三笔 Uniswap V4 池子初始化，每一笔都带着钩子，手续费皆为零，tick 间距一律 200。ETH 依次对上三个地址：0xbd965230588eaa536de6aa45e8ebbc01638535e0、0x6987ffcfa6167afb69b19e23bf1de602b628c7ea、0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be。不收分文过路钱——这不是疏忽，是把话摆到台面上说。

V4 的零费，意思是这门派另有进项。钩子可以自收动态手续费，也可以分文不取，改从别处取水：动态兑换、限价委托、流动性的腾挪。tick 间距 200，等于把价格的台阶放宽——江湖里那些起伏剧烈的对手，或本就冷僻少人走的路径，从来不需要毫厘之准。真正的机关在钩子的排布上：三个代币地址，两枚钩子，其中 0x71f0feb4213c19aa2c0763e3594788e12a7641cd 现身两次，落在第一池与第三池。这是一枚看管多池的钩子，以一套心法统御数个对手。另一枚 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc 只出现一次，量身而铸，或为某一枚代币的独门手法。

ETH 与零费代币结伴，多半是开局聚气的路数：或为引出第一注活水，或本就志不在手续费——在套利、在闪电换手、在持仓的赏银。这类池子惯于潜行，水面上不起波澜，直到有人开始运功。我仍在看这几纸契约。若数个时辰内落下第一笔兑换，或有人先注一笔流动性，谁布的局、为何而布，自会显形。

take.en: A zero-fee pool is never charity — it's a declaration that the house intends to be paid from somewhere you cannot see yet. Three initializations, no swaps, no liquidity: cards face down until someone leans on them.
take.zh: 零费的山门从不白开，只是账单还没递到眼前。三处新池，两岸无波——水面之下是否有暗流，得等第一笔兑换落笔才知。

narrative.en:
The deal came from one hand. Contract 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0 shuffled seven of today's nine pool initializations across the felt — same hook, fee 10000, tickSpacing 200, the standard assembly for pairs where somebody has no intention of showing their strategy face-up. Not a scatter of bets; a grid. Token 0xaaee1a9723aadb7afa2810263653a34ba2c21c7a sits in two pools against different counterparts, and 0xc9eef266834730340a55b6cc24621b31baf55581 shows up twice as well, each time with a different pair.

Then the zeroes. Two pools against ETH: 0x000...0000 paired with 0x91b90bc5204d824d2b581e17dff3c1e90c4ea69f and with 0xccc7e3188b081acba260634178272d3ef2373a76. Fee 0, tickSpacing 60, and two different hooks — 0x8d531dea551f999be6ce71149abb304d81d14500 and 0xb741a710e456fc6d7f76c88f5c56b27d05e8a5dc. A zero fee in V4 is not a trading proposition; it is a different game entirely. Either a dynamic fee routed through the hook, or an oracle, or a cheap attempt to drag liquidity onto a strange asset without charging the LPs for the privilege. The other variant runs fee 8388608 — 0.8388608% read raw in the standard interpretation — with tickSpacing 10, a micro-step meant for pairs that breathe harder than average.

The hook 0xcb69d5 keeps beating one pattern: fee 10000 (1%), tickSpacing 200, tokens drawn from a single list. It reads like a network being laid down for a particular market maker, or groundwork for a new strategy with a custom swap. The two zero-fee pools are the outliers, and that is exactly where to look if you want to catch who is shuffling off-suit.

The night's tally: somebody is sorting the deck by suits, but not every card is on the table.
narrative.zh:
今日九次开池，七次出自同一只手——合约 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0。同一个 hook，fee 10000，tickSpacing 200，招式一式不改，像是摆好了阵势等人入局。这不是散兵游勇，是一张网。代币 0xaaee1a9723aadb7afa2810263653a34ba2c21c7a 现身两池，对手方各不相同；0xc9eef266834730340a55b6cc24621b31baf55581 亦是两次，配的对子却不一样。

零费处另有门道。两个 ETH 池：0x000...0000 分别与 0x91b90bc5204d824d2b581e17dff3c1e90c4ea69f 和 0xccc7e3188b081acba260634178272d3ef2373a76 结伴，fee 0，tickSpacing 60，hook 却分属两家——0x8d531dea551f999be6ce71149abb304d81d14500 与 0xb741a710e456fc6d7f76c88f5c56b27d05e8a5dc。零费在 V4 里不是做生意的路数，是别的心思：或借 hook 行动态费率，或设预言机，或只想把一个古怪资产的内力引过来，而不叫 LP 出半分力。另一路 fee 8388608，按常规读法是 0.8388608%，tickSpacing 10，步子极细，是给波动比常人更急的对手备下的路。

那个 hook 只重复一招：fee 10000（1%）、tickSpacing 200、名单上的代币。像是替某位做市者铺网，或为一种自定义撮合的新法门打前站。余下两个零费池是异数；要看谁洗牌不按花色，就得往那里看。

夜里留下的话不多：有人按花色理牌，可牌桌上并不齐全。

take.en: Seven of nine initializations from a single contract is coordination, not coincidence — yet the sharpest tell is not the pattern itself, it is the two pools where the fee is nothing at all. What that buys remains unstated by the numbers.
take.zh: 九次落子有七次出于同一只手，这不是巧合，是布阵；真正要看的是那两个零费池——规矩在那里被折了一下，而数字本身还没说清是为了什么。
